topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: Well, now, that’s a strange turn, ain’t it? I was tellin’ Olaf about how I met up with young Tom the other day. We’ve known each other since I could shake a hoe. I went up to him, patting his back, and started talkin' about the old days, how we used to sneak into the orchards and swipe apples, hide from old Gertrude when she’d chase us down. He just looked at me, all puzzled, like I was a stranger. I thought maybe he was jest playin’ a trick, but no, he truly had no mind of us being friends. Keeps makin’ me wonder what else might turn unfamiliar in this life.
